user_decision: Execute steps 1-5 in order without requesting approval at every substep; preserve exact-once authorities and stop at a newly established L1 blocker rather than silently expanding or retrying.

execution_sequence.acceptance: A synthetic one-vector directory microcanary and a fresh 93-object R2 each close, reopen, bind identities, generate a canonical artifact receipt and publish a whole fresh root. R1 remains immutable.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: Any new backend/storage L1 consumes its attempt and stops step 1; no automatic R3. Retrieval quality is not inferred from build success.

execution_sequence.acceptance: DELL, MU, NVDA, ORCL, ASML and ANET run the same typed Query Facet matrix through exact, ObjectBM25, BGE-M3 and fusion. Every miss is explained in business language with the wrong or missing company, period, relation, section and content; aggregate scores alone are insufficient.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: Candidate ceiling is measured before fusion or reranking. If dense/fusion does not beat the sparse baseline on a declared use case, retain or restrict it instead of tuning to manufacture a pass.

execution_sequence.acceptance: Build fact, mechanism, counterevidence and typed-gap layers with exact source/date/identity/period/relationship lineage. Audit DELL first, transfer without core changes to MU/NVDA and then held-out cases.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: Candidate presence is not Evidence. A present candidate that cannot support the research claim remains a typed gap and is not repaired by Writer prose.

execution_sequence.acceptance: Only unresolved Evidence Slots trigger external search. Official SEC/issuer/industry routes lead; broad providers are locator shadows. Every fetched source is recaptured and locally rechecked for identity, date, relation direction and Evidence eligibility.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: Do not rerun broad search for slots already satisfied locally and do not let a reranker promote 0/10 useful candidates. Missing official content remains a typed gap.

execution_sequence.acceptance: First compare DeepSeek and the reference analysis on the same frozen Evidence Pack, then separately test dynamic planning/tool use. Evaluate company-specific thesis, mechanisms, counterevidence, what-would-change, source use and report usefulness, not only schema compliance.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: A weak fixed-pack report is a model/prompt synthesis issue; a good fixed-pack report but weak tool run is planner/orchestration; missing candidates or weak packs stay upstream. Do not hide these causes behind one overall score.

experiment_governance.primary_hypothesis: A financial-object-first local retrieval and Evidence pipeline, supplemented only for typed residual gaps, can produce materially stronger research inputs than the prior nine-call harness path.
baselines: prior three-case qrels sparse 16_of_18 dense 3_of_18 fusion 14_of_18
DeepSeek fixed-pack analysis before tool autonomy
leakage_controls: candidate generation before qrels or answer inspection
no gold URLs embedded in query or router
held-out ORCL ASML ANET cannot change core code during transfer
automatic narrative candidates stay quarantined until reviewed
experiment_governance.efficiency: Use zero-call replay and fixtures for contract changes; one natural canary per changed model contract family; one formal exact-live per clean candidate. Do not pay for field-by-field live repair.
experiment_governance.reporting: Every numeric metric is accompanied by concrete business examples of success and failure.

known_boundary: This plan preserves the approved five-step direction but does not make later-stage results true in advance. Each stage must materialize its own evidence and can stop the sequence on a genuine owning-stage L1 blocker.
